issue_title: [Bug] TOCTOU race condition in load(): file existence check and stat/read are not atom

ruff.command: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py tests/test_storage_atomicity.py

fix_summary: Handle TOCTOU race condition in TodoStorage.load() by catching FileNotFoundError around stat() and read_text() operations, eliminating the non-atomic exists() check that could race with file deletion.
